title: 23. Glinda the Good Witch Grants Dorothy's Wish
chineseTitle: 23. 吉inda善巫实现多莉的愿望

paragraphs.en: Upon arriving at the castle, Dorothy and her companions were led to a room where they prepared themselves. Dorothy washed her face and combed her hair, while the Lion shook out his mane, the Scarecrow straightened himself, and the Woodman polished his tin body.
paragraphs.zh: 抵达城堡后，多萝西和她的同伴被带到一个房间，准备一番。多萝西洗了把脸，梳理了一下头发；狮子抖了抖鬃毛，稻草人整理了下身体，樵夫则擦亮了他的锡制躯体。

paragraphs.en: They then entered a grand hall where Glinda, the Good Witch, sat on a ruby throne. She was both beautiful and youthful to their eyes, with rich red hair cascading over her shoulders and blue eyes that looked kindly upon Dorothy.
paragraphs.zh: 他们随后进入了一个宏伟的大厅，只见好巫婆Glinda坐在一颗红宝石王座上。在他们眼中，她既美丽又年轻，一头浓密的红发垂落在肩头，蓝色的眼睛温柔地注视着多萝西。

paragraphs.en: "What can I do for you, my child?" she asked.
paragraphs.zh: “孩子，你需要我帮你做什么？”她问道。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy recounted her journey: how the cyclone brought her to Oz, finding her friends, and their adventures. She expressed her wish to return to Kansas, fearing Aunt Em would mourn her absence if she didn't come back soon.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西讲述了她的旅程：龙卷风将她带到奥兹国，结识了朋友们，并经历了一系列冒险。她表达了希望返回堪萨斯的心愿，担心如果自己不尽快回去，艾姆姨妈会因她的缺席而悲伤。

paragraphs.en: Glinda leaned forward, kissed Dorothy's face, and assured her that a way existed to get home. However, Dorothy must give Glinda the Golden Cap in exchange.
paragraphs.zh: 格琳达向前倾了倾身子，吻了吻多萝西的脸颊，并向她保证回家的路确实存在。然而，多萝西必须把金帽交给格琳达作为交换。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy willingly handed over the cap. Glinda then turned to the Scarecrow, asking what he would do after Dorothy left. He replied that he would return to the Emerald City as its ruler and worry only about crossing the Hammer-Heads hill.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西情愿地交出了帽子。甘nda随后转向稻草人，询问他当多萝西离开后会怎么做。稻草人回答说，他会返回翡翠城担任统治者，并只关心如何穿越锤头山。

paragraphs.en: Glinda promised to use the Golden Cap to command the Winged Monkeys to carry the Scarecrow to the Emerald City gates. She then asked the Tin Woodman what his future held, though she already knew he would be taken there too.
paragraphs.zh: 格琳达承诺使用金帽来命令飞猴将稻草人送到翡翠城的城门。随后，她虽然已经知道铁皮人也会被一同带走，还是问了铁皮人他的未来会如何。

paragraphs.en: Glinda the Good Witch considered for a moment before speaking. "The Winkies were kind to me and wished me to rule their land after the Wicked Witch's death. I have fond feelings for them, and if I could return to the Country of the West, ruling over the Winkies would be my greatest wish."
paragraphs.zh: 格琳达好巫婆沉思了一会儿，才开口说道：“温基人对我很好，在恶女巫死后，他们希望我能统治他们的土地。我对他们怀有深厚的感情，如果能返回西方之国，统治温基人将是我最大的心愿。”

paragraphs.en: Glinda then addressed Dorothy: "Your brain may not look as large as the Scarecrow's, but you are truly brighter when polished—and I am sure you will rule wisely. As for the Lion, he said that after Dorothy returns home, he wishes to return to his forest kingdom where all beasts have made him their king."
paragraphs.zh: Glinda 然后对多萝西说道：“你的智慧并不比稻草人的大，但经过磨砺之后，你确实更加聪明——我相信你会明智地统治。至于狮子，他说等多萝西平安回家后，他希望能回到自己的森林王国，在那里所有的野兽都已拥戴他为王。”

paragraphs.en: Glinda then commanded the Winged Monkeys: "Carry the Lion safely back to his forest. After using up the Golden Cap's powers, I will give it to the King of the Monkeys so they can be free forevermore." The Scarecrow and Tin Woodman thanked Glinda for her kindness.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，格林达命令飞猴：“安全地将狮子送回森林。用完金帽的力量后，我会把它交给猴子之王，让他们从此永远自由。”稻草人和铁皮人感谢格林达的善举。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy expressed gratitude: "You are indeed as good as you are beautiful! But how do I get back to Kansas?" Glinda replied, "Your Silver Shoes will carry you over the desert.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西感激地说：“你不仅美丽，而且心地善良！但我怎么才能回到堪萨斯州呢？”格林达回答道：“你的银鞋会带你穿越沙漠。”

paragraphs.en: You could have gone home on the first day if you had known their power."
paragraphs.zh: 如果你了解他们的能力，你第一天就可以回家了。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow and Tin Woodman agreed, each lamenting what they might have missed without their new possessions: the Scarecrow his wisdom, the Tin Woodman his heart, and the Lion his courage.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人和铁皮人一致同意，各自感慨如果没有新获得的东西，他们可能会错过什么：稻草人失去了他的智慧，铁皮人失去了他的心，而狮子则失去了勇气。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy concluded, "Each of you has found happiness in your kingdoms. I think it's time for me to return home."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西总结道：“你们每个人都已在自己的王国中找到了幸福。我想是时候该我回家了。”

paragraphs.en: The Good Witch explained that Dorothy's silver shoes could transport her anywhere with three steps, each made in an instant. Excited, Dorothy wished to return home at once.
paragraphs.zh: 好巫婆解释说，多萝西的银鞋只需三步就能把她带到任何地方，每一步只需一瞬间。多萝西兴奋不已，立刻希望能马上回家。

paragraphs.en: She hugged Toto tightly, kissed the Lion and the Tin Woodman, and held back tears as she embraced the Scarecrow.
paragraphs.zh: 她紧紧地拥抱了托托，亲吻了狮子和铁皮人木乃伊，并在拥抱稻草人时强忍着泪水。

paragraphs.en: Glinda gave Dorothy a final kiss before she left. Grateful for Glinda's kindness, Dorothy thanked her.
paragraphs.zh: 格琳达在离开前给了多萝西一个最后的吻。感激格琳达的好意，多萝西向她表达了谢意。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy clapped her heels together three times, commanding, "Take me home to Aunt Em!" Instantly, she was spinning through the air so fast that only wind rushed past her ears.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西将脚跟重重地拍了三下，命令道：“带我回家去找艾姆姨妈！”顿时，她仿佛被一股强大的旋风卷起，在空中飞速旋转，只觉得耳边呼啸而过的只有狂风。

paragraphs.en: The Silver Shoes took just three steps, then stopped abruptly. Dorothy tumbled onto the Kansas prairie, rolling several times before coming to a stop.
paragraphs.zh: 银鞋只迈了三步，然后突然停了下来。多萝西摔到了堪萨斯大草原上，滚了几圈才停下。

paragraphs.en: She stood up and realized she was barefoot; the shoes had fallen off during her flight and were lost forever in the desert.
paragraphs.zh: 她站起身来，发现双脚赤裸；在飞行过程中，鞋子不知何时掉了，永远地消失在了沙漠中。

paragraphs.en: "Good gracious!" she exclaimed, seeing the familiar farmhouse Uncle Henry had built after the cyclone.
paragraphs.zh: “天哪！”她见到亨利叔叔在龙卷风后建造的那座熟悉的农舍，不禁脱口而出。
